claims.why_not_priced: A stopped 10b5-1 programme leaves no trace anywhere except as an absence in the EDGAR index, and nothing aggregates absences. The stock fell 54% from its 52-week high across exactly the window in which the selling stopped, so if the market had read the halt as a signal it would not still be 16% off its low. The honest alternative reading is that the plan simply expired, which is why I keep this modest.

claims.why_not_priced: Six company releases in eight weeks and the observable market response is nil - the same corpus records participants writing '7% revenue growth for a company selling AI agents is terrible' and 'growth here absolutely sucks'. The market is valuing the consolidated growth rate and ignoring the mix shift, and at a $185m market cap with $80.5m of cash there is no sell-side preview in this capture (n_queries=0 in all sweeps) to reconcile the two. Gartner MQ Leader status in the category is the kind of datapoint that changes an enterprise sales cycle and gets no price at all in a microcap.
